title: Wipro NLTH style · Aptitude
description: Logical, quantitative and verbal ability, as in Wipro's national hiring test. 52 MCQs in 48 minutes. Original practice questions modelled on the publicly reported test pattern. Not an official or past paper.

questions.text: Which number is the odd one out: 27, 8, 28, 729?
What comes next in the series: 13, 23, 33, 43, 53, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: add 10 each time. Next term = 63.
The rule is n → 2n + 3; for 7 it gives 17.

questions.text: Isha is 12th from the left and 8th from the right in a row. How many people are in the row?

Statements: Some phones are chairs. No chairs is pens.
Conclusion: Some phones are not pens.
Does the conclusion follow?
questions.explanation: Draw the Venn diagram for the statements: the conclusion must hold in every possible case.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 3, 13, 43, 133, 403, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: multiply by 3 and add 4. Next term = 1213.

questions.text: Esha is the father of Yash. Yash is the sister of Kavya. How is Esha related to Kavya?
questions.explanation: Kavya is Yash's sibling, so Esha is Kavya's father too.
a ⊕ b = ab + a + b; so 9 ⊕ 5 = 59.

questions.text: Gita is the mother of Chitra. Meera is the son of Chitra. How is Gita related to Meera?
questions.explanation: Gita is the mother of Meera's parent.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 3, 10, 24, 52, 108, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: multiply by 2 and add 4. Next term = 220.

questions.text: Bharat is taller than Kavya. Kavya is taller than Rahul. Pooja is taller than Ojas. Rahul is taller than Pooja. Who is the shortest?
questions.explanation: Chaining the clues: Bharat > Kavya > Rahul > Pooja > Ojas. The shortest is Ojas.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 5, 12, 26, 54, 110, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: multiply by 2 and add 2. Next term = 222.

questions.text: What comes next: H, K, N, Q, T, ?
A train 300 m long passes a pole in 18 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
A can finish a work in 40 days and B in 10 days. In how many days will they finish it working together?
The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 5:3. After 8 years, the ratio will be 7:5. What is A's present age?
questions.explanation: Let ages be 5x and 3x. (5x+8)/(3x+8) = 7/5 gives x = 4; A = 20.

questions.text: One word for: A person who has retired from work
questions.explanation: A person who has retired from work: pensioner.

questions.text:
